verdict.rationale: The evidence shows personal-account sign-in without API keys. The CLI documents a browser login flow (docs-49), ACP authentication uses a "cursor_login" method, and service-account docs refer to developers' personal accounts. Bringing your own API key is optional, since Cursor serves models by default and Tab always uses Cursor's built-in models. A community report of users creating new accounts to get more usage implies account-gated free usage exists, but no first-party evidence describes a free tier or its limits. missing for 10: first-party documentation of a free plan and its usage limits, explicit confirmation that a free account needs no API key, independent hands-on corroboration of free-tier sign-in
